Task: Silicon Surface Energy - Level 1
Description: Calculate the surface energy of Silicon in the given surface by removing periodic boundary conditions in the given direction and computing the energy difference per unit area between the bulk and surface configurations. Return the surface energy in eV/Å² units.

numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)

All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/.

- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10

- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-149
- direction: [0, 0, 1]
- atom_style: full
